    AI Overview
    A QR code event registration system lets attendees quickly sign up or check in via their smartphones. You can create a custom registration form and link it to a QR code to display on flyers, emails, or at your venue. 
    Here is a breakdown of the best platforms and methods to set this up for your event: 
    1. Free & Built-In Methods
    • Google Forms: Create your registration form in Google Forms, click "Send," grab the form link, and paste it into a free QR code generator like QR Code Generator. You can then download the QR code image and add it to your materials.
    • Microsoft Forms: Similar to Google, you can build a form in Microsoft Forms, use the built-in "Share" option to get the QR code, and download it for your event invitations. 
    2. Dedicated Event Platforms
    • Eventbrite: When attendees register, Eventbrite automatically generates a unique QR code ticket for each person, making on-site check-in seamless.
    • Jotform: Use the Jotform QR Code Scan Registration Form Template to capture attendee details, registration types, and consent agreements instantly.
    • RSVPify: Generate custom QR codes for your event invites, flyers, or landing pages on RSVPify to allow guests to RSVP with a quick scan. 
    3. How the Process Works
    1. Design the Form: Add fields for names, emails, dietary restrictions, and ticket quantities.
    2. Generate the QR Code: Convert the URL of your registration form into a scannable QR code.
    3. Event Day: Display the QR code at the entrance so walk-in guests can scan it to register instantly on their phones. 
    If you'd like, let me know:
    • Is this a free or paid event?
    • What is the estimated number of attendees?
    • Do you need to scan tickets for entry or just collect registrations?
